title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 65
description: Ten questions on Psalms 65: praise in Zion, the God who hears prayer, stills the seas, and waters and crowns the earth with abundance.

questions.text: Where does praise wait for God, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:1 says, "Praise waits for you, God, in Zion."

questions.text: How is God addressed in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:2 says, "You who hear prayer, all men will come to you."

answers.text: You who ride on the clouds
You who walk in the garden

questions.text: Sins overwhelmed the psalmist, but what did God do?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:3 says, "Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions."

questions.text: Why is the one whom God chooses and causes to come near blessed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:4 says this is so that he may live in God's courts.

answers.text: That he may rule over nations
That he may sail the sea
That he may live in God's courts

questions.text: What does God form by his power, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:6 says, "By your power, you form the mountains."

questions.text: What roaring does God still, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:7 says God stills the roaring of the seas and the roaring of their waves.

questions.text: What is the river of God full of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:9 says, "The river of God is full of water."

questions.text: With what does God soften the earth in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:10 says, "You soften it with showers."

questions.text: With what does God crown the year?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:11 says, "You crown the year with your bounty."

questions.text: With what are the pastures covered, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Psalms 65:13 says, "The pastures are covered with flocks."
